summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare IP address (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz) with certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false), extracts it into node_modules, chmods the extracted file to 0o755, and links it as the package's CLI binary. The destination is a bare IP rather than the publisher's domain, TLS verification is disabled, and no hash or signature check is performed on the downloaded executable before it is executed. This runs automatically on npm install, so any operator of that IP — or any on-path attacker exploiting the disabled TLS validation — can deliver arbitrary bytes that will execute on the installer's host as the package's launcher binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
